objective: Advance KIDULTS toward a globally leading Autonomous Global Intelligence Platform by reducing evidence starvation, source concentration, category/geography asymmetry, late integration risk and scorecard distortion without weakening empirical, rights, security or Production gates.

risk_controls.current_truth: Empirical ASI rebalancer 13 cells / 0 collection-computable / 0 analytical-computable / 0 live mutations; active collector-market dated-SOLD cells 0.
required_actions: Rank source acquisition by marginal reduction of UNKNOWN factors, not record volume.
Prioritize VENUE_DEPTH_AND_DIVERSITY, then MARKET_MATURITY, MARKET_SCALE, OBSERVED_TRANSACTION_ACTIVITY.
Require rights, freshness, provenance and source-owner independence before empirical admission.
Keep unsupported factor cells UNKNOWN with zero quota/weight mutation.
risk_controls.exit: At least one claim-sufficient lawful collector-market lineage and sufficient lawful multi-owner factors to make bounded SHADOW rebalancer computation defensible.

risk_controls.current_truth: Current admitted evidence ownership is narrow relative to global target and collector-current-market redundancy is 0.
required_actions: Measure evidence coverage by independent source owner, category, geography and evidence class.
Do not count duplicate feeds, aliases or republished records as independent owners.
Require source-removal sensitivity for any factor relying on multi-owner evidence.
Flag any production-eligible claim whose evidence collapses after removal of one owner.
risk_controls.exit: No production-eligible critical market claim depends on a single source owner unless explicitly classified as single-authority truth with a bounded claim ceiling.

risk_controls.current_truth: Architecture is multi-vertical/global while empirical factor coverage is materially uneven.
required_actions: Maintain category x geography x evidence-class coverage matrix.
Expose NOT_VERIFIED and UNKNOWN rather than filling gaps with proxy assumptions.
Select next evidence acquisition by business relevance x uncertainty reduction x source independence x rights feasibility.
Require representative cross-vertical compatibility before broad global claims.
risk_controls.exit: Global claims are bounded to empirically represented category/geography surfaces; no architecture-level coverage is reported as empirical coverage.

risk_controls.current_truth: No genuine immutable Candidate/Evidence pair has traversed Track B to live approved Projection.
required_actions: Continuously test Candidate/Evidence/Track-B/Projection schema and digest compatibility using explicitly synthetic or non-promotable shadow fixtures.
Prove downstream consumers reject missing, stale, tampered and rights-inadmissible claims.
Keep shadow rehearsal artifacts cryptographically and semantically non-promotable to empirical PASS.
On first genuine immutable pair, execute Track B and final workload replay immediately without redesign delay.
risk_controls.exit: Downstream chain is mechanically rehearsed and genuine first-pair traversal requires no contract/schema redesign.

risk_controls.current_truth: Strict evidenced completion is 17/100 and intentionally under-represents internal platform maturity because only final evidenced PASS counts.
required_actions: Preserve strict evidenced completion unchanged as Release Evidence Readiness.
Add Internal Platform Readiness as a separate non-release metric.
Add Empirical Evidence Readiness as a separate metric.
Never average the three axes into a single launch score.
Production eligibility remains governed only by canonical gates and explicit G5.
risk_controls.exit: KPMO reporting cannot confuse architecture maturity, empirical evidence completeness and release authorization.

deprioritization_rule: Any new architecture, engine, registry or governance work not directly reducing one of the four operating priorities defaults to P1_OR_LOWER unless a new P0 defect is evidenced.
